::: {.callout-important appearance="simple"}
Your complete project — R script, dataset, written report — was due **via Canvas before midnight Sunday**. No late submissions, no appeals. Presentations happen in class today.
:::

## Format

- Short presentation of your project to the class: your research question, data, methods, results, and what they mean
- **You will walk through your code and explain how and why it works.** Being unable to confidently explain your own code will affect your grade — this is the point of the [AI policy](../syllabus.qmd#use-of-artificial-intelligence-tools)
- Questions from the class and from me

## What makes a good presentation

- Lead with the question, not the code
- One clear visualization beats three cluttered ones
- Interpret in plain language: what would you tell a police chief, a judge, or a journalist?
- Own your limitations — every real analysis has them, and naming them is a strength

Thank you for a great semester. 🎓
